# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Bespoke Estate Agents are delighted to bring Number 183 Clifden Court to the market. This property is situated within a well maintend development, boasting a large open lobby and central courtyard, as well as secure underground parking. Located on the quays in Dublin 7 this is a super location with a host of local ameneties as well as transport links throughout Dublin and farther afield.
